import zlib
import pickle
import socket

def test():
    mydict = [
        {"name": "alice", "age": 17},
        {"name": "mike", "age": 21}
    ]

    with open("test.gz", "wb") as f:
        f.write(zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(mydict)))
    
    with open("test.gz", "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
        successDict = pickle.loads(data)
    
    with open("test.gz", "wb") as f:
        f.write(zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(successDict)))
    
    with open("test.gz", "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
        remote_socket = socket.socket()
        remote_socket.connect(("remote_server", 8081))
        remote_socket.sendall(data)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test()
